protocol.reason: User explicitly requested small training comparisons, then full training of the best development configuration
protocol.fixed: Candidate correction ±.08 rad, unchanged revision2 gate, LQR, training distribution and all unlisted PPO/reward/actuator settings. Only the named candidate dimensions differ.
protocol.development_grid: Each candidate: 2 pilot-trained seeds x 3 speeds x 2 known paths x 6 regions =72 gated episodes; 72 paired LQR episodes once; total360. No final reserved noise used.
protocol.selection: Eligible if aggregate survival >= paired LQR and nominal mean penalized RMSE <=1.02*LQR. Among eligible choose minimum mean penalized RMSE over all72 development cells; exact ties by candidate declaration order. If none eligible choose maximum survival then minimum RMSE, explicitly mark selection not development-qualified. Freeze selected config, source/model/data hashes before full training and final test.
protocol.full_training: Train only the selected configuration, scratch at five full seeds, fixed1M per seed. Do not extend a pilot or select best checkpoint. Do not retrain other configurations after inspecting final results.
protocol.final_comparison: 900 episodes from revision3/protocol.json with fresh base4910000; new selected policies compared to LQR, old gated residual and old simply rescaled residual; ungated new residual ablation retained.
protocol.limits: Two short-run seeds give a noisy development ranking, not a guarantee that the same candidate is optimal after full training. Physical exploration variance changes with log_std and action scaling. Gate stays outside standalone training. Native runs are interface checks only.
